## YouTube Script Generator (Lite)
Enter a topic, get a structured faceless-video script (Hook, Setup, Facts, Theories, Ending) plus 5 title ideas.

**Setup (3 min)**
1. Create a *Header Auth* credential: Name `x-api-key`, Value = your Anthropic API key.
2. Select it in the node **Claude: write script**.
3. Activate the workflow and open the form URL.

**Want the full pipeline?** Google Sheets topic queue, Telegram approval and ElevenLabs voice-over per section, saved to Google Drive:
https://thaproduct.github.io/ai-solopreneur-blog/en/n8n-youtube-pipeline-template/
